task-defaults:
    run-on-repo-type: [hg]
    description: 'libotr library build'
    worker-type: b-linux-docker-amd
    worker:
        max-run-time: 1800
    treeherder:
        kind: build
        platform: toolchains/opt
        tier: 1
    run-on-projects: []
    run:
        using: comm-toolchain-script
        script: build-libotr.sh
        toolchain-artifact: public/build/libotr.tar.xz

linux64-libotr:
    treeherder:
        symbol: TL(libotr)
    run:
        arguments: ['linux64']
    fetches:
        toolchain:
            - linux64-clang
            - sysroot-x86_64-linux-gnu

linux-aarch64-libotr:
    treeherder:
        symbol: TLA64(libotr)
    run:
        arguments: ['linux-aarch64']
    fetches:
        toolchain:
            - sysroot-aarch64-linux-gnu
            - linux64-clang

macosx64-x64-libotr:
    treeherder:
        symbol: TM(libotr)
    worker:
        env:
            MACOS_SDK_DIR: "MacOSX26.5.sdk"
            MACOS_TARGET_SDK: "10.15"
    run:
        arguments: ['macosx64']
    fetches:
        toolchain:
            - linux64-cctools-port
            - linux64-clang
            # Uses the SDK for builds, not the -toolchain SDK
            - macosx64-sdk

macosx64-aarch64-libotr:
    treeherder:
        symbol: TMA64(libotr)
    worker:
        env:
            MACOS_SDK_DIR: "MacOSX26.5.sdk"
            MACOS_TARGET_SDK: "11.0"
    run:
        arguments: ['macosx64-aarch64']
    fetches:
        toolchain:
            - linux64-cctools-port
            - linux64-clang
            - macosx64-sdk

win32-libotr:
    worker:
        docker-image: {in-tree: tb-debian-mingw}
    treeherder:
        symbol: TW32(libotr)
    run:
        arguments: ['win32']

win64-libotr:
    worker:
        docker-image: {in-tree: tb-debian-mingw}
    treeherder:
        symbol: TW64(libotr)
    run:
        arguments: ['win64']
